name: toon-mcp-squeeze
description: Re-encode JSON returned by MCP tools as TOON before Claude reads it, cutting tokens on large tabular results

include_tools.title: Tools to convert
include_tools.description: Regex matched against the whole MCP tool name, e.g. mcp__github__.*|mcp__kubernetes__.*

exclude_tools.title: Tools to skip
exclude_tools.description: Regex matched against the whole tool name; matches are never converted. Leave empty for none

min_bytes.title: Minimum size (bytes)
min_bytes.description: Text blocks smaller than this pass through unchanged

toon_path.title: toon executable
toon_path.description: Absolute path to toon when it isn't on Claude Code's PATH (e.g. installed under nvm). Leave empty to use PATH
